rows.itemTitle: FRANCHISOR ASSISTANCE ADVERTISING COMPUTER SYSTEMS AND TRAINING
rows.summary: Marriott's 2026 Item 11 materially expands and repackages required hotel technology (PMS transition, legacy systems, MCN failover, Continent Field Support, M365, EV, EDR/MDR, MESH, Guest Messaging), raises or restructures many computer and training costs, and relaxes the Red Zone audit trigger while lowering FITM and some implementation cost estimates.
